Children to face double extreme fire weather in Europe: study

Children born after 2025 in Europe are projected to experience nearly twice the amount of extreme fire weather compared to their great-grandparents, according to a study. This intensification of fire-conducive weather is linked to intensifying global heating. The threat is described as exponential for children born today, particularly in regions like Spain.
